type: Additional check of the earlier distributed-heating Bunny regime, distinct from the four localized-adjoint workloads
geometry: Same 69674-triangle Bunny and fixed 512 sites/cavity used in the new localized-adjoint test
PDE: -Laplace u = 1 + 0.65 y, zero Dirichlet walls; compliance J=int f u, hence p=u
TWoS: Analytic affine-source ball integration r^2 f(center)/6; off-diagonal estimate of u^2; path budgets 16,64,256,1024,4096
multigrid: One primal solve suffices for both u and p; same four resolution budgets, solved-field/outer-mask reuse, and warm start after the edit
seeds_counts_reference: Same five seeds, 8/32/128/512 sites, MG193/257 and eight independent 8192-walk spot batches, unchanged reference gates and 10/20/40% targets
scope: New query experiment on an existing PDE type; not a replication of the exact old site pool or hardware, not a fixed-total-heat design experiment; added after the original three engineering-geometry results
adaptive_stopping_frozen_before_extensio: Always measure 16/64/256 paths at all counts. At 1024 and 4096, measure only prefixes through the largest still-unresolved query count in each state. A case is closed when a previous budget meets the strictest reference-resolved target (10%, then 20%, then 40%) using the unchanged upper-bootstrap-mean error rule, or when no target has a resolved reference. Retain stop reasons and all measured budgets. This selects the smallest tested path budget attaining the target, not an exhaustive high-budget Pareto front.
iteration_cap_amendment: MG257 did not meet the unchanged 1e-7 residual tolerance within 120 cycles. Increase the maximum to 800 for this workload (including all grid budgets); retain actual time to convergence and the failure record. No tolerance relaxation.
